verdict.rationale: Gazebo Fuel serves as a model registry: you can pull prebuilt robot models such as PR2, Pioneer2 DX, iRobot Create and TurtleBot, and add them to your own SDF by copying a snippet from the model page. The evidence shows a custom-plugin system and Gazebo vendor packages, but no registry or ecosystem for reusable behavior modules, and pulling models relies on copy-pasting snippets rather than a dependency-managed package workflow. Missing for 10: a registry or catalog of reusable behavior/plugin modules, documented package-manager-style dependency resolution for Fuel assets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
